explanation: Generated eta EXCLURAD inputs for 25 physically valid points at W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, and phi*=0 to 345 deg in 25 equal steps. Inputs were chunked into 3 files because this tool writes at most 10 points per file. No kinematic fixes were needed. Used the eta campaign default beam energy 6.53 GeV and default vcut 0.166 GeV^2 in full O(alpha) mode; this is valid, but radiative corrections depend on beam energy, so the beam energy should be stated with any reported results.
